before.title: 7-Speed Dual-Clutch (DCT) Judder and Premature Clutch Failure
before.description: Souls with the 1.6L Turbo-GDI and 7-speed dry dual-clutch transmission exhibit low-speed clutch judder (a body shake accelerating from a stop, worst on cold/humid mornings), harsh engagement, and hesitation. The dry clutches glaze/wear during stop-and-go creeping. Kia's diagnosis is a creep-driving test: if the body vibrates without steering-wheel shudder, it is clutch judder. TSB TRA083 first applies a TCU anti-judder logic update, then replaces the dual-clutch assembly if hardware is glazed/worn.
before.solution: Kia creep-test diagnosis; first step is a TCU/software anti-judder logic update via KDS, then dual-clutch assembly replacement per TSB TRA083 if judder persists.

citations.title: NHTSA TSB - 7-Speed DCT Judder Inspection & Dual-Clutch Assembly Replacement (TRA083)
NHTSA TSB - 7-Speed DCT Anti-Judder Logic Update
2021 Kia Soul DCT DIY adjustment and morning shudder

proposal.title: 7-Speed Dual-Clutch (DCT) Judder and Premature Clutch Failure
proposal.description: Kia TSB TRA083 documents clutch judder on limited 1.6L turbo Soul populations: PS vehicles built August 8-October 27, 2016 and SK3 vehicles built November 24, 2018-April 2, 2020. It defines judder through a KDS creep-driving measurement. The frozen page overgeneralizes that evidence to every indexed 2017-2020 vehicle and cites TRA098, an Optima-only anti-judder update.
proposal.solution: Verify the VIN, production date, transmission hardware and symptom before repair. For a TRA083-eligible vehicle, a Kia dealer or qualified DCT technician performs the KDS judder measurement and replaces the dual-clutch assembly with the bulletin-required TCU procedure only when indicated. Do not apply Optima Event 541, diagnose P0810 or assume every 2017-2020 Soul shares one failure cause from this page.
symptoms: Body vibration or judder while accelerating from a stop requires production-date and KDS verification
affectedSystems: 7-speed DCT dual-clutch assembly, synchronizer hardware and TCU logic

before.title: ABS/HECU Module Brake-Fluid Leak Causing Engine Compartment Fire
before.description: The Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit (HECU/ABS module) can develop an internal electrical short (fluid leakage plus localized PCB melting was found in retrieved units), producing excessive current that can cause an engine-compartment fire while parked or driving. NHTSA recall 23V-652 covers 349,309 2011-2013 Souls equipped with Electronic Stability Control, part of the broader Kia/Hyundai 'park outside' fire-risk campaign. Owners were told to park outside and away from structures until repaired.
before.solution: Recall remedy: dealer installs new fuse(s) in the HECU electrical circuit to prevent an overcurrent condition, free of charge under NHTSA 23V-652 (Kia SC284). Interim notices mailed late 2023; remedy available as of mid-2024.

proposal.title: ABS/HECU Module Brake-Fluid Leak Causing Engine Compartment Fire
proposal.description: NHTSA recall 23V652000 (Kia SC284) covers 349,309 certain 2011-2013 Soul vehicles equipped with Electronic Stability Control. The HECU may experience an electrical short and cause an engine-compartment fire while parked or driving. Kia’s Part 573 report states that the exact cause of the short remains unknown, so the frozen title’s brake-fluid causal wording is not treated as established fact.
proposal.solution: Check the VIN for recall 23V652000. Until repaired, park outside and away from structures. A Kia dealer installs lower-amperage HECU fuse protection free of charge. Do not buy an ABS module or infer a brake-fluid repair from this page; the recall filing does not establish the exact short-circuit cause.
affectedSystems: Hydraulic Electronic Control Unit electrical circuit and fuse

before.title: Catalytic Converter Overheating and Engine Piston Damage
before.description: NHTSA recall 19V120000 (Kia SC176) covers 2012-2016 Soul vehicles with the 1.6L GDI engine. Excessive exhaust-gas temperature can damage the catalytic converter, leading to abnormal combustion, piston damage, connecting-rod failure, stall or fire. Kia’s later SC176Y bulletin addresses certain previously repaired vehicles with P0420, with or without a P030X misfire code.
before.solution: Check the VIN and campaign history with Kia. SC176 calls for the Catalytic Overheating Protection ECU update and replacement of a damaged converter or engine as necessary, free of charge. For an eligible SC176Y vehicle with P0420, the dealer follows Kia’s compression-test flow before choosing converter or engine replacement. Do not infer P0430 or purchase radiator, coolant or generic exhaust parts from this page.
symptoms: Loss of power, abnormal combustion or engine damage
affectedSystems: 1.6L GDI catalytic converter, ECU protection logic and engine

before.title: Electric Motor Bearing Noise (Soul EV)
before.description: The Soul EV (2015-2020) can develop a whining or grinding noise from the electric drive motor due to bearing wear. The front motor bearing deteriorates prematurely, particularly in cold climates. The noise is most noticeable at low speeds when other road noise is minimal. Kia has replaced drive motors under warranty for some owners.
before.solution: Have dealer inspect electric drive motor bearings. If worn, the drive motor assembly is replaced under powertrain warranty. Aftermarket repair involves pressing new bearings into the motor housing ($400-800 at an EV specialist). OEM motor replacement is $2,000-4,000 if out of warranty.
symptoms: Whining noise from front of vehicle at low speeds
Noise increases with speed but masked by road noise above 30 mph

citations.title: KiaForums.com - Soul EV motor bearing whine discussion
Reddit r/SoulEV - Motor noise diagnosis thread

communityRecommendations.content: Have the dealer document the noise on the work order even if not yet severe enough for replacement. This creates a warranty claim trail if it worsens
Mobil 1 75W-90 synthetic gear oil for differential and transfer case
Fel-Pro gasket kit for drivetrain service

proposal.title: Electric Motor Bearing Noise (Soul EV)
proposal.description: The frozen page labels a 2015-2020 Soul EV whine as premature front-motor-bearing wear, but the complete official Soul inventories reviewed here contain no exact Kia package establishing that all-year defect or a cold-climate cause. Similar noise can originate in the drive motor, reduction gear, shafts, tires or wheel bearings.
proposal.solution: Record when the noise occurs and whether it changes with vehicle speed, motor torque, regeneration or steering, then have an EV-qualified technician isolate the source with the exact VIN and service information. Do not add gear oil, open the high-voltage drive unit, press in generic bearings or buy a drivetrain gasket kit from this page.
symptoms: Whine or grinding that changes with vehicle speed requires EV drivetrain diagnosis
affectedSystems: Soul EV drive motor, reduction gear, shafts and wheel bearings

before.title: Motor-Driven Power Steering (MDPS) Flexible Coupling Noise
before.description: Kia TSB CHA074 covers 2010-2013 Soul vehicles in its listed production range and attributes a knock or click while turning at a stop to premature wear of the MDPS motor’s flexible coupling. Kia WTY013 separately extended flexible-coupling coverage to 10 years/unlimited mileage for 2012-2013 Soul vehicles; it does not extend every other MDPS component or the 2010-2011 vehicles.
before.solution: Have the noise diagnosed against CHA074 and the exact VIN. If premature coupling wear is confirmed, follow Kia’s Soul-specific procedure to replace only the improved flexible coupling. Check WTY013 eligibility for a 2012-2013 vehicle. Do not order a generic coupler or replace the full MDPS column without the current Kia parts catalog, fitment and steering-service procedure.
symptoms: Clicking or knocking from the MDPS while turning the steering wheel at a stop

before.title: Panoramic Sunroof Spontaneous Shattering
before.description: The optional panoramic glass sunroof can spontaneously shatter without impact, often at speed, showering occupants with glass and accompanied by a loud bang. NHTSA opened an investigation into Hyundai/Kia panoramic sunroof shattering in 2013 (expanded 2014) but closed it without finding a safety-related defect, citing possible road-debris contribution. A long-running class action alleged a manufacturing/tempering defect; after roughly a decade it was ultimately dismissed in Kia's favor.
before.solution: No recall; sunroof glass is replaced out of pocket or via insurance/goodwill. Aftermarket ceramic film is sometimes applied to help contain fragments if it shatters again.
symptoms: Sunroof glass shatters into small pieces
Occurs without impact, often at speed

before.title: Piston Oil Ring Defect and Excessive Oil Consumption
before.description: NHTSA recall 21V259000 (Kia SC209) covers certain 2020-2021 Soul vehicles with 2.0L Nu MPI engines whose piston oil rings may not have been properly heat-treated. Kia communication 11017169/SST082 indexes a later PNSS vibration-inspection process to certain 2020-2023 Soul vehicles and describes ring-related cylinder-wall damage, increased oil consumption, abnormal noise, oil-pressure warning and P1327. That later bulletin does not make every 2022-2023 vehicle part of recall 21V259.
before.solution: Check the VIN for SC209 or the current Kia PNSS program and monitor the oil level using the owner-manual procedure. A Kia dealer uses the VIN-driven KDS inspection; eligible recall vehicles receive inspection, PNSS software and engine replacement when necessary. Do not promise a one-quart-per-1,000-mile threshold, apply recall coverage to every 2022-2023 Soul, infer P0420/P0171/P0174 or buy oil and filters as a remedy for damaged rings.
affectedSystems: 2.0L Nu MPI piston oil rings, cylinder walls and PNSS diagnostics

The campaign supersedes 14V332 and 15V736, including vehicles previously repaired under those campaigns.
before.solution: Check the VIN for recall 17V608000 and arrange prompt Kia dealer service. The dealer inspects and secures the pinion plug or replaces the steering-gear assembly as necessary, free of charge. If steering control changes, stop safely and arrange towing. Do not buy tie-rod ends or a remanufactured rack as a substitute for the recall remedy.
symptoms: Increased steering play or loss of steering control may occur
affectedSystems: steering-gear pinion plug and pinion gear

The dealer inspects and secures the pinion plug or replaces the steering-gear assembly as necessary, free of charge. If steering control changes, stop safely and arrange towing. Do not buy tie-rod ends or a remanufactured rack as a substitute for the recall remedy.
symptoms: Increased steering play or loss of steering control may occur
affectedSystems: steering-gear pinion plug and pinion gear
